# K0maru Agent Memory

> Single-static-binary (3.6 MB pure-Rust core), zero-daemon long-term memory hub and sub-10ms Living ADR Guard for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Gemini CLI). Converts human-authored Markdown Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) into deterministic Git pre-commit and Claude Code Stop-hook guardrails with zero-LLM memory supersession and bounded <300 token loadouts.

## Core Capabilities

- **Sub-10ms Living ADR Guard**: Declarative architectural invariants defined in Markdown Architecture Decision Records are enforced deterministically in <10ms in-memory (~15–55ms CLI end-to-end with git diff subprocess; <35ms Claude Code Stop-hook), halting non-compliant agent edits before commit or user handoff.
- **Deterministic Zero-LLM Supersession (`k0maru flush --supersedes`)**: When architectural patterns evolve (e.g., migrating from Redis locks to distributed token leases), a single command atomically marks obsolete ADRs as `status: superseded`, strips inbound WikiLink graph boosts, hot-swaps active guard rules, and eliminates stale belief entrenchment without LLM re-indexing.
- **Diff-Aware Bounded Loadouts (<300 Tokens)**: Inspects staged and unstaged Git diffs to assemble dynamic, minimal cognitive backpacks of repository mission, core invariants, and recent decisions, preserving model attention within the high-accuracy cognitive Smart-Zone.
- **Zero Daemon, Single Static Binary**: Zero background processes, zero open network ports, 3.4ms cold start, and disposable SQLite cache (`cache.sqlite` rebuilds in 74ms).
- **Dual Search Architecture**: Hybrid retrieval uniting SQLite FTS5 BM25 keyword matching with local ONNX/FastEmbed vector search for sub-millisecond retrieval of troubleshooting playbooks and architectural history.

## Quick Install & Zero-Human Onboarding

External AI coding agents and human developers can bootstrap repository-level architectural governance in seconds:

```bash
# 1. Download and install standalone binary
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/K0maru/k0maru-agent-memory/main/install.sh | bash

# Or via Homebrew
brew install K0maru/tap/k0maru

# 2. Autonomous one-command bootstrap inside any Git repository
# Generates .mcp.json (Claude Code), .cursor/mcp.json (Cursor),
# .claude/settings.local.json (Stop-hook), and .git/hooks/pre-commit
k0maru init --install

# 3. Verify installation health and MCP client bindings
k0maru doctor
```

### Autonomous Agent Execution Loop

1. **SessionStart**: Automatically triggers `k0maru loadout "<project>" --diff` to inject <300 tokens of project context and active ADR invariants.
2. **Mid-Session Exploration**: Query architectural history and troubleshooting playbooks via `k0maru search "<query>"` or FastMCP `recall_memory`.
3. **Pre-Yield / Claude Stop-hook (`hooks.Stop`)**: Runs `k0maru guard check --diff --claude-stop-hook`. If violations exist, exits with code 2 to trigger autonomous self-healing before human sees the output.
4. **Pre-Commit (`.git/hooks/pre-commit`)**: Evaluates staged changes against ADR invariants in `<10ms`, rejecting non-compliant commits.
5. **Post-Commit (`.git/hooks/post-commit`)**: Incremental `k0maru sync` and automated milestone crystallization in `01_AI_Logs/` for `feat:`, `fix:`, `refactor:`, `perf:`, and `adr:` commits.

### Self-Healing Protocol on `[DENY]` Violation

When `k0maru guard check --diff` halts with `[DENY]`:
- **Accidental Violation**: Read the `remediation:` message, modify code to conform, and re-run `k0maru guard check --diff`.
- **Intentional Architectural Migration**: Execute supersession to retire the deprecated invariant and register the new rule:
  ```bash
  k0maru flush \
    --category decision \
    --title "ADR-New: Distributed Token Leases" \
    --supersedes "ADR-Old: Legacy Redis SetNX" \
    --summary "Replaced legacy unscoped locks with fenced distributed token leases" \
    --content $'## Non-Negotiable Invariants\n- [fenced-lease-required] (deny) [src/settlement/**/*] must_contain: "acquire_fenced_lease" | remediation: "All settlement flows must acquire fenced leases."'
  git add .k0maru/wiki
  ```

## CLI & FastMCP Reference

### Core CLI Subcommands

- `k0maru init [--vault <path>] [--install]`: Initialize workspace, setup git hooks, and wire agent MCP configurations.
- `k0maru sync [--full] [--vector]`: Incrementally parse Markdown notes, extract K-DSL rules, and build search indexes.
- `k0maru loadout <project> [--diff]`: Generate bounded <300 token context backpack with diff-aware invariant extraction.
- `k0maru search <query> [--vector] [--limit <n>]`: Search architectural decisions and playbooks with BM25 or ONNX vectors.
- `k0maru guard check [--diff] [--claude-stop-hook] [--path <file>]`: Check code against active ADR rules (<10ms).
- `k0maru guard list`: List active architectural rules across the repository.
- `k0maru flush --category <cat> --title <title> [--supersedes <title>] --summary <sum> [--content <txt>]`: Crystallize decisions and execute atomic rule supersession.
- `k0maru doctor`: Validate repository bindings, hook integrity, and client configs.
- `k0maru mcp run`: Launch standard FastMCP stdio server.
- `k0maru prune [--dry-run]`: Remove orphaned database records and compact cache.

### FastMCP Tools Reference

- `get_project_loadout(project: string, diff?: boolean)`: Injects <300 token bounded architectural backpack.
- `guard_check(diff?: boolean, staged?: boolean, claude_stop_hook?: boolean, path?: string)`: Evaluates AST/regex rules against changes.
- `recall_memory(query: string, mode?: string, limit?: number)`: Retrieves relevant notes and playbooks.
- `flush_session(category: string, title: string, summary: string, content?: string, supersedes?: string)`: Crystallizes ADRs with supersession.
- `distill_session_skill(trace: string, title: string, category?: string)`: Distills compiler/terminal errors into playbooks.

## Empirical Benchmarks

- **Diff-Aware Loadout Token Footprint**: Bounded `< 300 tokens` (measured: `168 tokens` for standard projects; `245 tokens` under complex multi-rule diffs).
- **Supersession Self-Healing**: `100% Pass@1` autonomous remediation in 1 turn across verified models (`DeepSeek V4.1 Flash`, `Qwen2.5-Coder-7B`, and `Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct`).
- **Session Trajectory Context GC**: `86.58% TRR` (Token Reduction Ratio) on 50-turn conversational logs (`16,830 tokens` compacted to `2,259 tokens` while preserving hot-turn cognitive context).
- **Symbolic Offloading TRR**: `99.44%` token reduction on massive terminal dumps and compiler stack traces (`cargo test`, `pytest`).
- **Binary Footprint**:
  - `3.6 MB` pure-Rust core binary (`cargo build --release --no-default-features`) with FTS5 BM25 search, Living ADR Guard, and MCP stdio server.
  - `19 MB` (macOS arm64) / `34 MB` (Linux x86_64) release binary bundling `fastembed` + ONNX Runtime (15.5 MB compressed download).
- **Cold-Start Latency**: `3.4 ms` native cold-start, `~11.7 MB` RAM footprint during execution, released immediately on process exit.
